title: Keto Dessert Board
seo_title: Keto Dessert Board: Berries, Mascarpone & 90% Chocolate
description: A keto dessert board for 8: mascarpone, goat cheese, raspberries, blackberries, strawberries, pecans, macadamia nuts, coconut, whipped cream and 90% dark chocolate.
hook: Berries, mascarpone and 90% chocolate: a dessert board with about 7 g net carbs per serving.
why: Mascarpone whipped with a little vanilla and cinnamon is the dip, and fresh whipped cream is the second one. Berries are the lowest-sugar fruit there is, which is why raspberries, blackberries and strawberries are the only fruit here.
Goat cheese gives a tangy contrast, pecans, macadamias and coconut flakes add crunch, and 90% dark chocolate is rich enough that a little goes a long way.

timeline.what: Whip the cream with a dash of vanilla (no sugar); chill.
Take out the mascarpone and goat cheese to soften.
Rinse and dry the berries; halve the strawberries.
Toast the coconut flakes in a dry pan; build the board.
Add the whipped cream and mint. Serve.

faq.q: What can you put on a keto dessert board?
faq.a: Mascarpone or whipped cream, berries, pecans, macadamia nuts, coconut flakes, 85% to 90% dark chocolate and a tangy cheese like goat cheese.
Berries are the best choice: raspberries and blackberries have the fewest net carbs, then strawberries.
About 7 g net carbs per serving for 8.
